chunks: With this chain of transmission, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about urine that affects the garment, so he said: “Wash it twice.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, a title of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.اغْسِلْهُ: wash it, the direct command to purify the garment
key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by impurity
key_terms.الْبَوْلِ: urine, the impurity being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: twice, specifying the number of washes required

ai.seo_question: How should a garment be purified if urine gets on it according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity and the cleansing of clothing affected by urine. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that the garment is to be washed twice, indicating the required method of purification in this case.
